info.title: Levius
info.synopsis: La guerra ha tolto molto al giovane Levius: suo padre è morto, mentre lui ha perso un braccio nel tentativo di salvare sua madre, che ora è in coma. Il braccio gli è stato sostituito con una protesi cibernetica e ora vive con suo zio Zacks che si occupa non certo disinteressatamente di lui, per avviarlo al brutale sport del cyber boxing.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Against his trainer's wishes, Levius uses his spin hook on his opponent. Despite the risk of mechanical failure, he wants to keep using it.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Levius's uncle Zack takes him in after his mother is injured during the war. They struggle to connect until Levius shows an interest in boxing.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Malcolm Eden's last five bouts have all ended in his opponent's death. Zack pleads with Levius to forfeit the upcoming fight, but Levius refuses.

episodes.synopsis: Team Levius prepares for the next fight: Bill fabricates a new arm, while Zack and Natalia help Levius train. Malcolm Eden volunteers to assist.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Levius's new arm fails the first inspection. When Bill's frantic fixes don't solve the issue, Levius proposes a radical and life-threatening solution.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The fight with AJ begins, with both their futures on the line. AJ's inhuman movement and inability to feel pain make her a formidable foe.
